audit.why: Mel owns 1-2 on range, Zed owns 3 through first item on shadow burst, Mel returns at 2+ items grouped. Content matches the packet chart; full aligned to it.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] names 'E Contempt of the Shadows' — fabricated: Zed's E is Shadow Slash, Contempt for the Weak is his passive.

Five content fields (whys[6], spikes[1], spikes[3], late, wants.you[1] — also packet suspectName) say Golden Eclipse (R) 'reflects' the Death Mark detonation. Mel's reflect/damage-prevention is Rebuttal (W); her R is the execute. Also missing: Zed's R dash is untargetable — don't spend answers into the blink.
audit.why: Kit: mel W = barrier that prevents damage and reflects projectiles; mel R = strike marked enemies. zed R flag: untargetable. Missing-interactions lists untargetable-dodges-burst.
audit.corrected: All five fields moved to Rebuttal blanking the detonation; untargetable-dash timing folded into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.why: Kit: Death Mark 120/110/100, Living Shadow 20-16, Mel W 38-26.

edits.after: W Living Shadow plus double-Q is real kill threat — hold your snare for the shadow dash, farm safe.

edits.before: Late Mel is a counter-artillery battery: reflect their poke, snare their dive, and execute the chipped.
edits.after: Grouped, your snare peels his dive and Rebuttal blanks the mark — he must sidelane you to win now.

edits.before: - Zed Death Mark: matchup-defining — The all-in — spend your defensive answer AFTER the mark lands, not before. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Rebuttal has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Death Mark: 120s at rank 1 — his R dash is untargetable, so spend your answer AFTER he lands, never into the blink. - Living Shadow is 20-16s: a Zed without W is a minion. - Your W Rebuttal (38s early) answers the detonation, not the poke. - R goes to the kill window only.

edits.before: Q-volley the last-hit, bank the overwhelm stacks, and keep W glowing — the chip is free while his best spells are hostages.
edits.after: His Q is the one projectile he owns — the glow makes shuriken poke a losing trade, and a W-less Zed can't start a combo.

edits.before: Burning Rebuttal on chip and then eating the full rotation it existed to return — the reflect is the matchup; spend it like a verdict.
edits.after: Only Razor Shuriken can be reflected — Living Shadow, Shadow Slash and the Death Mark dash all walk straight through your glow.

edits.before: Two items plus flips it back to you as teamfights let Golden Eclipse reflect his engage and your snare peels him.
edits.after: Two items plus flips it back to you as Rebuttal blanks his engage in teamfights and your snare peels him off.

edits.before: This is Zed's window and you have to respect it. Once he has Q Razor Shuriken plus W Living Shadow and E Contempt of the Shadows, he can double-Q you through the shadow for huge poke and slow you with E for the follow-up. Your Rebuttal only shields a short window, so if you get caught out of position his shadow-poke chunks you below his all-in threshold. Farm safe, hold E Solar Snare purely defensively for his W-dash, and don't walk up for CS while both his shadows are loaded.
edits.after: This is Zed's window and you have to respect it. Once he has Q Razor Shuriken plus W Living Shadow and E Shadow Slash, he can double-Q you through the shadow for huge poke and slow you with E for the follow-up. Your Rebuttal only shields a short window, so if you get caught out of position his shadow-poke chunks you below his all-in threshold. Farm safe, hold E Solar Snare purely defensively for his W-dash, and don't walk up for CS while both his shadows are loaded.

edits.before: Zed's 6 is the scariest point in the lane: his R Death Mark ults onto you, marks you, and the shadow-Q burst detonates for a kill if you're low. Golden Eclipse can save you here — reflect his mark damage — but the timing is tight and if he baits your R first he kills you clean. Buy early Seeker's or a Verdant Barrier component and never sit at half health with his ult available.
edits.after: Zed's 6 is the scariest point in the lane: his R Death Mark ults onto you, marks you, and the shadow-Q burst detonates for a kill if you're low. Rebuttal can save you here — the barrier blanks the detonation — but the timing is tight and if he baits your W first he kills you clean. Buy early Seeker's or a Verdant Barrier component and never sit at half health with his ult available.

edits.before: Once you have two-plus items the matchup swings back to you: teamfights let you hold Golden Eclipse for his R engage and reflect the Death Mark burst back onto him. Zed diving your backline commits his shadow and W, and a clean Solar Snare peels him off before his mark detonates. Group, don't duel — sidelane isolation is where he still beats you.
edits.after: Once you have two-plus items the matchup swings back to you: teamfights let you hold Rebuttal for his R engage and blank the Death Mark burst as it detonates. Zed diving your backline commits his shadow and W, and a clean Solar Snare peels him off before his mark detonates. Group, don't duel — sidelane isolation is where he still beats you.

edits.before: Two items plus and you climb back ahead: in grouped fights Golden Eclipse reflects his Death Mark burst and your snare peels his all-in off your carries. Zed has to isolate you in a sidelane to win now, so never give him that — group, hold R for his engage, and turn his own combo against him. The extended, multi-person fight is where Mel's reflect-and-execute kit finally out-scales his single-target burst.
edits.after: Two items plus and you climb back ahead: in grouped fights Rebuttal blanks his Death Mark burst and your snare peels his all-in off your carries. Zed has to isolate you in a sidelane to win now, so never give him that — group, hold W for his engage, and execute the diver with Golden Eclipse. The extended, multi-person fight is where Mel's reflect-and-execute kit finally out-scales his single-target burst.

notes: Content win[] matches the packet chart, so full sides were edited alone with matching whys and ratings. Fixed the systematic misattribution of the Death Mark answer to Golden Eclipse — Mel's damage-prevention barrier is Rebuttal (W); whether W timed on the mark pop fully negates the stored-damage detonation is asserted by the existing text and consistent with 'prevents her from taking damage', but the exact interaction is not in Riot's text — listed unverified. Fabricated 'E Contempt of the Shadows' corrected to Shadow Slash.
